newsitem.title: MEXICO: Companies register for Mexico gas distribution bid.
newsitem.headline: Companies register for Mexico gas distribution bid.

text.p: Companies began the bidding process for gas distribution in the northern Mexican state of Chihuahua by registering with the nation's Federal Energy Regulation Commission.

The commission said six companies already signalling intent to bid are: NorAM Energy de Mexico, Repsol Mexico, DGN Distribuidora de Gas Natural de Mexicali, Triturados Basalticos y Derivados, Distribuidora de Gas del Norte and Tenneco Gas Latin America, Inc.
Interested companies have until Jan. 23, 1997 to state their bid, the commission said. Bidders must prove five years' experience and service at least 100,000 clients.
The gas distribution zone includes the metropolitan areas of Chihuahua, Cuautemoc-Anahuac and Delicias in the state of Chihuahua.
